parse_text: the ell of Venice. At Goa, and other parts, they use a larger cando, equal to fenteen Dutch alls preceding that of Bahd and Ballons by a par centum, and the vers by 64. In Siam, they use the lava, short of the Paris fet for one inch. The ken contains two dots, the folk two keedy, the keub twelve minor or inches, the nion to be equal to eight grains of one i, e. to shoot nine links. At Cambioia, they ule the latter; in Japan, the triatum and the fpan on fome of the cotails of Guinea.
